description: TGWAB action-pinning only—DEV-STANDARDS §15. Place at renovate.json.
WHEN TO USE THIS INSTEAD OF templates/renovate.json. That one is written for
pnpm repos: its first line says so, and it carries constraints.pnpm, which §15
requires to equal the root package.json packageManager pin. In a repo with no
pnpm — or, in two of this template's first three adopters, no package.json at
all — that MUST is unsatisfiable and the file would assert a repo type its own
repo is not. A committed file making a false claim about itself is the defect
this section spent v2.73.0-v2.77.0 removing; shipping one to 45 repos to avoid
writing a second template is not a trade worth making.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT, so the next person does not restore it by
reflex. Four of templates/renovate.json's five packageRules are INERT where
there is no package.json: the nvm group, the node/pnpm/npm group, the
astro+tailwind group, and the npm non-major group. constraints.pnpm is absent
for the same reason. A repo that later grows a package.json should adopt
templates/renovate.json instead of accreting those rules here.
WHAT IS PRESENT AND WHY. config:best-practices is the whole point: it extends
helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests, which sets pinDigests:true for depTypes
action and workflow. Verified against Renovate 44.69.6's shipped preset
source rather than its documentation — the chain is
config:best-practices -> helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests ->
{ matchDepTypes: [action, workflow], pinDigests: true }. That is what CONVERTS
a tag to a digest; Dependabot never does, which is the §15 finding this
template exists to act on.
NO schedule:weekly, unlike the pnpm template, and it is a deliberate trade.
Action digests change rarely, so weekly batching buys little here — and a
schedule would mean a staged rollout tells you nothing for up to a week, when
the entire point of staging is a fast read on whether Renovate opens a
DIGEST-PINNING pr or merely a version bump. prConcurrentLimit and
prHourlyLimit remain, so throttling does not depend on the schedule. If three
repos prove noisy, add the schedule before going wider — that is the order
with evidence behind it.
